#   resolved, it returns 0. SILENT. gap 106 CLOSED: p167's "10 of 15 trees have no interop standard"

# NEW FALSE-POSITIVE CLASS - T198, the eighth: BASE64 / INTEGRITY-HASH COLLISION IN LOCKFILES.
#   A 3-letter uppercase acronym under \b...\b will hit base64 payloads. Case-insensitivity was NOT
#   the cause: \bqti\b case-insensitive returns the same single lockfile hit.
#   Had this probe been published unresolved it would have FIRED ITS OWN FALSIFIER on a hash.
